By investing in education and training programs, we can help low-skilled workers acquire the skills they need to compete in the modern economy, and ultimately earn a higher wage. This approach would not only benefit workers but also contribute to the long-term health and competitiveness of our economy. A higher minimum wage would undermine the competitiveness of our Mittelstand, which is the backbone of our manufacturing sector. We cannot afford to ignore the economic realities of our country.
